name: pastel-teddy-blonde-girl
image_vibe: Joyful soft-yellow teddy-print styling with playful seated energy and clean studio polish
image_purpose: Create a playful fashion lookbook portrait for a pastel editorial or campaign concept.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman seated sideways on a tall wooden stool in pastel teddy-bear-print styling.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long voluminous blonde hair in soft loose waves, a warm natural complexion, delicate defined features, a bright joyful smile, and a confident approachable expression. She wears a fitted sleeveless soft pastel-yellow bodysuit with an evenly distributed teddy-bear print in warm brown and red, plus white mid-calf socks with delicate ruffled lace trim.
prompt.composition_elements: Full or three-quarter portrait, subject seated sideways on a tall wooden stool with torso rotated toward camera, upright elongated spine, relaxed shoulders, both hands gripping the seat edges, one knee raised and the other near the stool support, against a smooth seamless light-gray studio backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with even gentle shadows, clean pastel fashion-catalog mood, controlled warm yellow and brown-red print accents, and a minimal distraction-free environment.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial studio photography, 85mm lens, f/5.6, natural skin tone variation and visible pores, realistic hair strands, fabric, lace, wood, and stool texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with long voluminous blonde hair styled in soft loose waves, a warm natural complexion, delicate defined features, and a bright joyful smile. Dress her in a fitted sleeveless soft pastel-yellow bodysuit with an evenly distributed teddy-bear print in warm brown and red, plus white mid-calf socks with delicate ruffled lace trim. Seat her sideways on a tall wooden stool with her torso rotated toward camera, spine elongated, shoulders relaxed, both hands gripping the stool seat edges, one knee raised and the other near the lower support. Use a smooth seamless light-gray backdrop, soft diffused studio lighting, an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic pores, hair, fabric, lace, and wood texture, subtle film grain, clean playful fashion-editorial polish, and no text or watermark. Use an original adult face and do not imitate a public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed stool, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source pastel teddy-bear fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the pastel-yellow teddy print, blonde waves, stool pose, white lace socks, and light-gray studio; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult fashion subject, pastel-yellow teddy-print bodysuit, lace-trimmed socks, wooden stool, seated pose, joyful expression, and clean studio mood. Use an original face; identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Removed the default public-figure name and reframed the subject as an original adult.
Retained the specified outfit, pose, and playful fashion intent.
